title: State of the City 2026 Sizzle
description:
What an incredible year it's been in Santa Monica!

State of the City: From Realignment to Renaissance will take place on Thursday, July 23, from 4 to 7 p.m. at the Ocean Park Branch Library and along Main Street between Hollister Avenue and Ocean Park Boulevard.

Join us for this free, family-friendly celebration to explore Main Street and learn about all the great things happening in our city!

📍 Main Street between Hollister Avenue and Ocean Park Boulevard
🎤 Live performances
🎨 Activities, giveaways booths and more
🍻 Activation of the Main Street Entertainment Zone
🏛️ Meet the Mayor & city of Santa Monica staff members

More info at santamonica.gov
